origin: Claude Code 2.1.168 request with the system prompt as one string, as an SDK client writes it: derived from the capture by joining the blocks. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and the thinking fields are those Claude Code sends for it (adaptive, effort high). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
